title: myrrhis bulbosa
intro: Myrrhis bulbosa, commonly known as sweet cicely, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Western Asia. Its health benefits include the potential to aid digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of sweet cicely include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of infection. The bioactive constituents of Myrrhis bulbosa include myristicin, a lignan with potential antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
